structure_note: Verified against the official NCA ECC-1:2018 document: 5 main domains, 29 subdomains, 114 main controls (the 114 count = the x-y-z main controls; deeper x-y-z-w items are sub-control clauses summarized inside each control's intent).

domains.title_ar: الأمن السيبراني المتعلق بالأطراف الخارجية والحوسبة السحابية

controls.title_en: Define and approve a cybersecurity strategy
controls.intent: A documented cybersecurity strategy must be defined, approved and sponsored by the authorizing official, with goals aligned to relevant laws and regulations.
A roadmap must be executed to put the cybersecurity strategy into practice.
The strategy must be reviewed at planned intervals or when related laws and regulations change.
A dedicated cybersecurity function (e.g. department) must exist, independent of IT/ICT, ideally reporting to the head of the organization without conflict of interest.

controls.title_en: Staff the CISO and critical roles with qualified Saudi professionals
controls.intent: The head of the cybersecurity function and related supervisory/critical positions must be filled by full-time, experienced Saudi cybersecurity professionals.
A steering committee with defined membership, roles and governance must be established to support cybersecurity programs, including the cybersecurity function head.

controls.title_en: Define and disseminate cybersecurity policies and procedures
controls.intent: Policies and procedures must be defined by the cybersecurity function, approved by the authorizing official, and communicated to relevant parties.
The cybersecurity function must ensure the defined policies and procedures are actually implemented.

controls.title_en: Support policies with technical security standards
controls.intent: Policies must be backed by technical security standards for platforms such as operating systems, databases and firewalls.
Policies must be reviewed at planned intervals or on legal/regulatory change, with approved and documented updates.

controls.title_en: Define and assign cybersecurity roles and responsibilities
controls.intent: The cybersecurity organizational structure and its roles must be defined, approved and assigned by the authorizing official without conflict of interest.
Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities must be reviewed at planned intervals or on legal/regulatory change.

controls.title_en: Define a cybersecurity risk management methodology
controls.intent: A risk management methodology and procedures must be defined and approved, based on confidentiality, integrity and availability of assets.
The risk management methodology and procedures must be implemented by the cybersecurity function.

controls.title_en: Perform risk assessments at key trigger points
controls.intent: Risk assessments must run at least at early project stages, before major infrastructure changes, when planning third-party services, and before going live with new services/products.
The risk management methodology must be reviewed periodically or on legal/regulatory change, with documented approved updates.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity in Information and Technology Project Management
controls.subdomain_ar: الأمن السيبراني ضمن إدارة المشاريع المعلوماتية والتقنية
controls.title_en: Embed cybersecurity in project and change management
controls.intent: Cybersecurity requirements must be built into project and asset change management to identify and manage risk across the project lifecycle.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity in Information and Technology Project Management
controls.subdomain_ar: الأمن السيبراني ضمن إدارة المشاريع المعلوماتية والتقنية
controls.intent: Change management must at least cover vulnerability assessment and remediation, plus configuration review, secure configuration, hardening and patching before go-live.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity in Information and Technology Project Management
controls.subdomain_ar: الأمن السيبراني ضمن إدارة المشاريع المعلوماتية والتقنية
controls.intent: Development projects must at least use secure coding standards, trusted/licensed tools and libraries, compliance testing, secure integration, and hardening before release.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity in Information and Technology Project Management
controls.subdomain_ar: الأمن السيبراني ضمن إدارة المشاريع المعلوماتية والتقنية
controls.intent: Cybersecurity requirements within project management must be reviewed periodically.

controls.subdomain_en: Compliance with Cybersecurity Standards, Laws and Regulations
controls.subdomain_ar: الالتزام بتشريعات وتنظيمات ومعايير الأمن السيبراني
controls.intent: The organization must comply with related national cybersecurity laws and regulations.

controls.subdomain_en: Compliance with Cybersecurity Standards, Laws and Regulations
controls.subdomain_ar: الالتزام بتشريعات وتنظيمات ومعايير الأمن السيبراني
controls.intent: The organization must comply with any nationally-approved international cybersecurity agreements and commitments.
The cybersecurity function must periodically review implementation and compliance of cybersecurity controls in the organization.
Audits/reviews must be performed by parties independent of the cybersecurity function (e.g. internal audit), in line with GAAS and relevant laws, without conflict of interest.
Audit/review results must be documented and presented to the steering committee and authorizing official, including scope, observations, recommendations and remediation plans.
Personnel cybersecurity requirements covering before, during and after employment must be defined, documented and approved.
The defined personnel cybersecurity requirements must be implemented.
Before employment, contracts must include cybersecurity responsibilities and non-disclosure clauses, and candidates for critical/privileged roles must be screened/vetted.
During employment, personnel must receive cybersecurity awareness (onboarding and ongoing) and comply with organizational cybersecurity policies.
Personnel access to information and technology assets must be reviewed and immediately removed upon termination or separation.
Personnel cybersecurity requirements must be reviewed periodically.
An approved awareness program must be developed and run periodically through multiple channels to build a positive cybersecurity culture.
The cybersecurity awareness program must be implemented.

controls.title_en: Cover key threat topics in awareness content
controls.intent: Awareness must at least cover secure handling of email (especially phishing), mobile devices and storage media, secure internet browsing, and safe use of social media.
Tailored training and skillsets must be provided to cybersecurity staff, developers/asset operators, and executive/supervisory positions.
Implementation of the awareness program must be reviewed periodically.
Cybersecurity requirements for managing information and technology assets must be defined, documented and approved.
The defined asset management cybersecurity requirements must be implemented.
An acceptable use policy for information and technology assets must be defined, documented and approved.
The acceptable use policy for information and technology assets must be implemented.
Assets must be classified, labeled and handled according to related legal and regulatory requirements.
Asset management cybersecurity requirements must be reviewed periodically.

controls.title_en: Define identity and access management requirements
controls.intent: Cybersecurity requirements for identity and access management must be defined, documented and approved.

controls.title_en: Implement identity and access management requirements
controls.intent: The defined identity and access management requirements must be implemented.

controls.title_en: Core IAM control set (MFA, least privilege, PAM)
controls.intent: IAM must at least cover username/password authentication, MFA for remote access, need-to-know/least-privilege authorization with segregation of duties, privileged access management, and periodic access reviews.
Implementation of the identity and access management requirements must be reviewed periodically.

controls.subdomain_en: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
controls.intent: Cybersecurity requirements for protecting information systems and processing facilities must be defined, documented and approved.

controls.subdomain_en: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
controls.intent: The defined information system and processing facility protection requirements must be implemented.

controls.subdomain_en: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
controls.title_en: Core host protection set (anti-malware, media, patching, clock sync)
controls.intent: Protection must at least include advanced up-to-date malware/virus defense on servers and workstations, restricted external media use, patch management, and centralized clock synchronization from a trusted source (e.g. SASO).

controls.subdomain_en: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
controls.intent: System and facility protection cybersecurity requirements must be reviewed periodically.
Cybersecurity requirements for protecting the email service must be defined, documented and approved.
The defined email service protection requirements must be implemented.

controls.title_en: Core email defense set (anti-phishing, MFA, archiving, APT, SPF)
controls.intent: Email protection must at least include filtering phishing/spam, MFA for remote/webmail access, email archiving and backup, protection against APTs/zero-days, and domain validation (e.g. SPF).
Email service protection requirements must be reviewed periodically.
Cybersecurity requirements for network security management must be defined, documented and approved.
The defined network security management requirements must be implemented.

controls.title_en: Core network defense set (segmentation, IPS, DNS, wireless, ports)
controls.intent: Must at least include firewall segregation/segmentation with defense-in-depth, prod/test/dev separation, secure browsing/internet restrictions, protected wireless (with prior risk assessment), service/protocol/port restrictions, IPS, DNS security, and APT protection for browsing.
Network security management requirements must be reviewed periodically.

controls.title_en: Define mobile device and BYOD requirements
controls.intent: Cybersecurity requirements for mobile device security and BYOD must be defined, documented and approved.

controls.title_en: Implement mobile device and BYOD requirements
controls.intent: The defined mobile device and BYOD security requirements must be implemented.
Must at least include separation and encryption of organizational data on devices/BYOD, controlled use by job need, secure remote wipe on loss/theft/separation, and user security awareness.
Mobile device and BYOD security requirements must be reviewed periodically.
Cybersecurity requirements for protecting and handling data and information must be defined, documented and approved per related laws and regulations.
The defined data and information protection requirements must be implemented.

controls.title_en: Core data protection set (ownership, classification, privacy)
controls.intent: Must at least include data ownership, data classification and labeling mechanisms, and data privacy.
Data and information protection requirements must be reviewed periodically.
Cybersecurity requirements for cryptography must be defined, documented and approved.
The defined cryptography requirements must be implemented.

controls.title_en: Core cryptography set (approved standards, key management, encryption)
controls.intent: Must at least include approved cryptographic standards within technical/regulatory limits, secure key lifecycle management, and encryption of data in-transit and at-rest per classification and law.
Cryptography requirements must be reviewed periodically.
Cybersecurity requirements for backup and recovery management must be defined, documented and approved.
The defined backup and recovery management requirements must be implemented.

controls.title_en: Core backup set (scope, fast recovery, restore testing)
controls.intent: Must at least include backup scope covering critical assets, ability to recover data/systems quickly after incidents, and periodic tests of backup recovery effectiveness.
Backup and recovery management requirements must be reviewed periodically.
Cybersecurity requirements for technical vulnerability management must be defined, documented and approved.
The defined technical vulnerability management requirements must be implemented.

controls.title_en: Core vuln management set (periodic scans, classification, remediation, patching, feeds)
controls.intent: Must at least include periodic vulnerability assessments, criticality-based classification, risk-based remediation, security patch management, and subscription to trusted vulnerability intelligence sources.
Technical vulnerability management requirements must be reviewed periodically.
Cybersecurity requirements for penetration testing exercises must be defined, documented and approved.
The defined penetration testing processes must be implemented.

controls.title_en: Core pentest set (internet-facing scope, periodic testing)
controls.intent: Must at least cover penetration test scope for internet-facing services (infrastructure, websites, web/mobile apps, email, remote access) and conducting tests periodically.
Penetration testing processes must be reviewed periodically.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
controls.subdomain_ar: إدارة سجلات الأحداث ومراقبة الأمن السيبراني
controls.title_en: Define event log and monitoring requirements
controls.intent: Cybersecurity requirements for event logs and monitoring management must be defined, documented and approved.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
controls.subdomain_ar: إدارة سجلات الأحداث ومراقبة الأمن السيبراني
controls.title_en: Implement event log and monitoring requirements
controls.intent: The defined event log and monitoring management requirements must be implemented.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
controls.subdomain_ar: إدارة سجلات الأحداث ومراقبة الأمن السيبراني
controls.title_en: Core logging/monitoring set (critical-asset logs, privileged/remote logs, SIEM, 12-month retention)
controls.intent: Must at least include event logs on critical assets, logs for remote access and privileged accounts, use of a log-collection technology (e.g. SIEM), continuous monitoring of events, and a minimum 12-month log retention.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
controls.subdomain_ar: إدارة سجلات الأحداث ومراقبة الأمن السيبراني
controls.intent: Event log and monitoring management requirements must be reviewed periodically.

controls.title_en: Define incident and threat management requirements
controls.intent: Requirements for cybersecurity incident and threat management must be defined, documented and approved.

controls.title_en: Implement incident and threat management requirements
controls.intent: The defined incident and threat management requirements must be implemented.

controls.title_en: Core incident set (IR plans, classification, NCA reporting, threat intel)
controls.intent: Must at least include incident response plans and escalation procedures, incident classification, reporting incidents to the NCA, sharing notifications/indicators/reports with the NCA, and collecting/handling threat intelligence feeds.

controls.title_en: Periodically review incident and threat management
controls.intent: Incident and threat management requirements must be reviewed periodically.
Cybersecurity requirements for physical protection of information and technology assets must be defined, documented and approved.
The defined physical protection requirements must be implemented.

controls.title_en: Core physical set (access control, CCTV/records, secure destruction)
controls.intent: Must at least include authorized access to sensitive areas (e.g. data centers), entry/exit records with CCTV monitoring, protection of those records, secure destruction/reuse of media, and physical security of devices inside and outside facilities.
Physical protection requirements must be reviewed periodically.
Cybersecurity requirements for external web applications must be defined, documented and approved.
The defined external web application security requirements must be implemented.

controls.title_en: Core web app set (WAF, multi-tier, HTTPS, MFA)
controls.intent: Must at least include a web application firewall, multi-tier architecture, secure protocols (e.g. HTTPS), a clear secure usage policy for users, and multi-factor authentication for user access.
External web application security requirements must be reviewed periodically.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity Resilience Aspects of Business Continuity Management (BCM)
controls.subdomain_ar: جوانب صمود الأمن السيبراني في إدارة استمرارية الأعمال
controls.intent: Cybersecurity requirements for business continuity management must be defined, documented and approved.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity Resilience Aspects of Business Continuity Management (BCM)
controls.subdomain_ar: جوانب صمود الأمن السيبراني في إدارة استمرارية الأعمال
controls.intent: The defined business continuity management cybersecurity requirements must be implemented.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity Resilience Aspects of Business Continuity Management (BCM)
controls.subdomain_ar: جوانب صمود الأمن السيبراني في إدارة استمرارية الأعمال
controls.title_en: Core resilience set (continuity of security, response and DR plans)
controls.intent: Must at least ensure continuity of cybersecurity systems and procedures, response plans for incidents affecting business continuity, and disaster recovery plans.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity Resilience Aspects of Business Continuity Management (BCM)
controls.subdomain_ar: جوانب صمود الأمن السيبراني في إدارة استمرارية الأعمال
controls.intent: Business continuity management cybersecurity requirements must be reviewed periodically.
Cybersecurity requirements for contracts and agreements with third parties must be identified, documented and approved.

controls.title_en: Third-party contract clauses (NDA, incident comms, compliance)
controls.intent: Third-party contracts (e.g. SLAs) must at least include non-disclosure and secure data-removal clauses, incident communication procedures, and third-party compliance with organizational policies, laws and regulations.

controls.title_en: IT outsourcing/managed-services requirements (risk assessment, in-Kingdom SOC)
controls.intent: Contracts with IT outsourcing and managed-services providers must include a risk assessment before signing/on regulatory change, and require managed security monitoring/operations centers to be located inside Saudi Arabia.
Third-party contract cybersecurity requirements must be reviewed periodically.

controls.subdomain_ar: الأمن السيبراني المتعلق بالحوسبة السحابية والاستضافة
controls.title_en: Define cloud and hosting cybersecurity requirements
controls.intent: Cybersecurity requirements for using hosting and cloud computing services must be defined, documented and approved.

controls.subdomain_ar: الأمن السيبراني المتعلق بالحوسبة السحابية والاستضافة
controls.title_en: Implement cloud and hosting cybersecurity requirements
controls.intent: The defined cloud and hosting cybersecurity requirements must be implemented.

controls.subdomain_ar: الأمن السيبراني المتعلق بالحوسبة السحابية والاستضافة
controls.title_en: Core cloud set (data classification, tenant separation, in-Kingdom hosting)
controls.intent: In addition to domains 1-3 and subdomain 4-1, must at least include data classification before hosting and return in usable format, separation of the organization's environments from other tenants, and hosting/storage of data inside Saudi Arabia.

controls.subdomain_ar: الأمن السيبراني المتعلق بالحوسبة السحابية والاستضافة
controls.title_en: Periodically review cloud and hosting requirements
controls.intent: Cloud and hosting cybersecurity requirements must be reviewed periodically.
Cybersecurity requirements for industrial control systems and operational technology (ICS/OT) must be defined, documented and approved.
The defined ICS/OT cybersecurity requirements must be implemented.

controls.title_en: Core ICS/OT set (segmentation, SIS isolation, monitoring, patch/vuln, media/mobile restrictions)
controls.intent: Beyond domains 1-4, must add strict internal/external network segmentation, continuous monitoring and logging, isolation of Safety Instrumented Systems, tight external-media and mobile-device limits, periodic hardening, vulnerability and patch management, and malware protection for industrial systems.
ICS/OT cybersecurity requirements must be reviewed periodically.
